import sys, json, subprocess, time
WRAPPER = '''
import resource, sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("aud", "/app/submission/entry.py")
aud = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(aud)
aud.main()
sys.stderr.write("MAXRSS_KB=%d\\n" % resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
'''
def measure(doc_bytes, label):
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", WRAPPER], input=doc_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    rss = p.stderr.decode().strip()
    print("%-24s %6.2fs %10d out  %s" % (label, dt, len(p.stdout), rss))
EOF

import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from perf import cfg, pk, dg, trace, hexs, MAXN
import mem
evs = []
rnd = random.Random(3)
for i in range(3750):
    frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": (j % 8) * 4, "offset": rnd.randrange(0, 40000),
               "data_hex": hexs(rnd.choice([0, 8, 32])), "fin": False} for j in range(16)]
    evs.append(dg(i, 1200, [pk("A", i, frames)]))
doc = {"version": 1, "traces": [trace("p2", evs, max_stream_data=65536, max_data=MAXN, overlap="first")]}
mem.measure(json.dumps(doc).encode(), "P2 60000 frames")
# 2 MiB delivered
evs = []
pn = 0
for i in range(32):
    for j in range(4):
        frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": i * 4, "offset": j * 16384 + k * 2048,
                   "data_hex": hexs(1024, k + j), "fin": False} for k in range(8)]
        evs.append(dg(pn, 1200, [pk("A", pn, frames)])); pn += 1
doc = {"version": 1, "traces": [trace("p11", evs)]}

# 20000 packets * 64 PING frames? frames cap 60000 -> use 3 frames each
